subject: COPY statement
notes: GR7: 'If the REPLACING phrase is not specified, the library text is included in the resultant text unchanged.' ApplyReplacements returns the mapped text untouched when the replacement list is empty (active.Count == 0 -> return mapped); the only transformation is §6.5 logical conversion (NormalizeCopybookMapped), which the spec itself performs before text manipulation (§7.2.1 Step 1). The golden copy_nested_five_levels (expected L5, the copybook's VALUE, derived from GR12) incorporates library text unchanged across five levels. || editions (adjudicator): 85, 2002, 2014, 2023 (COPY statement present in every edition; Annex E.2 item 1 bullet 4 touches only non-pseudo-text REPLACING operands at 2023)
